title: Wilbert Ross confident tPH adaptation of ‘Pee Mak’ will make viewers laugh
summary: Wilbert Ross is confident that the Philippine adaptation of Thai blockbuster “Pee Mak,” which he leads alongside Bea Binene, will have audiences laughing in cinemas.
